usage: deskops faq [-h] [--format {text,json,yaml}] [--faq-path FAQ_PATH]
                   [question]

Browse the first-use FAQ by question.

positional arguments:
  question              Question index, slug, or text fragment. Omit to list
                        available questions.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --format {text,json,yaml}
                        Output format.
  --faq-path FAQ_PATH   FAQ markdown path (default: docs/faq.md; when it does
                        not exist, the FAQ packaged with deskops at
                        data/faq.md is used)
